responsibility: This module is GCC’s target backend and offloading support for NVIDIA PTX/NVPTX devices. It defines the NVPTX machine model, options, and instruction selection needed to turn GCC IR and RTL into PTX assembly, with the core backend split across the main target implementation files, target header, and machine description: the nvptx source files install target hooks for calling conventions, addressing, memory-space handling, builtins, PTX operand/assembly emission, and OpenMP/OpenACC device-specific lowering such as SIMT execution, privatization, reductions, and gang/worker/vector support, while nvptx.md provides the declarative RTL patterns and nvptx.h plus the mode/option headers describe the ABI, data layout, supported modes, and command-line controls. The module also includes C-family target preprocessor builtin support, generator scripts and SM definition tables that derive supported sm_* architecture predicates and -misa= option data, and the mkoffload tool and offload support headers that package compiled PTX device images for host linking and runtime registration, making this directory the focal point for both PTX code generation and GCC’s NVPTX OpenMP/OpenACC offload pipeline.
